artifacts.summary: Confirms both dependency edges (tasks 369, 445) landed; identifies the shared merge.lua hook_valid_set_key(event,matcher,identity) as the exact tuple to reuse; finds the lint has no deployed-tree concept today and needs a new Check E with a matcher-aware inventory; finds Gate 21 already wires the gate with zero verify-deploy.sh/gate-registry.data changes needed; finds shape-(c) existence must be checked against the deploy target's own directory (not the source store) to actually catch the dispatch's own cited lean4 example; and re-validates the dispatch's field-instance premises (Logos/Theory and Logos/Website already remediated by task 369; ModelBuilder still genuinely drifted; lean4's cited shape (c) is a different, still-open defect).

memory_candidates.content: In this nvim-config source-store repo, a bash lint auditing a DEPLOYED .claude/settings.json for file existence must resolve existence relative to the deployed file's own directory ($(dirname DEPLOYED_FILE)/<norm>), never via the source-store-relative glob pattern ($PROJECT_ROOT/agent-system/extensions/*/<norm>) that existing source-declaration checks (e.g. lint-hook-registration-paths.sh Check D) correctly use. A script can be fully present and correctly declared in the source store while still being absent from one specific deploy target's own filesystem (confirmed field case: theorem_proving_in_lean4 missing claude-stop-notify.sh/wezterm-preflight-status.sh despite both existing in agent-system/extensions/core/hooks/) -- reusing the source-store-relative check for a deployed-tree audit produces a false negative on exactly this defect class.

merge.lua (this repo's Claude Code extension loader) exports M.hook_valid_set_key(event, matcher, identity) -- the normative (event, matcher, hook-identity) tuple key for 'is this the same hook registration', shared with hook_identity.lua's M.identity(command, hook_type). Any new bash-side consumer needing to compare a deployed hook-registration set against the source-declared union should rebuild this exact tuple shape (via the existing hook_identity_cli.lua nvim bridge for identity resolution) rather than defining a second notion -- this is the specific divergence task 369 (orphan_sweep_for_removed_merge_target_entries) closed and that a second definition would silently reopen.

verify-deploy.sh's gate-registry.data has a requires_source_store field per gate row; Gate 21 (lint-hook-registration-paths.sh) already sets it true and already scrapes every [VIOLATION]-prefixed line from the lint's --verbose output into FINDINGS_LIST. A new check added INSIDE an already-gated lint script (rather than a new standalone script) is wired into verify-deploy.sh for free -- no new gate id, no gate-registry.data edit, no gateNN_run function needed -- as long as the new check's own preconditions (e.g. needing the source store on disk) match the existing gate's requires_source_store value and the new violations use the same [VIOLATION] prefix convention.
